title: builtin.cond.target_in_range parameters
description: Succeeds when the entity stored in a blackboard key is a current contact within range_m meters. Fails if the key is unset or the entity is not (or no longer) a contact.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target (read only).

range_m.description: Maximum distance in meters (3D range of the contact, inclusive).
